_doc: RI-005 / RI-006 fixture. Inbound Anthropic tool_result carries text+image content blocks. XLI's translate_inbound_to_responses_input CURRENTLY emits a function_call_output with the text-only flattened payload (image silently DROPPED at tool_result_text() in src/messages_server/inbound.rs — only AnthropicContentBlock::Text contributes to the joined string). The image-preservation closure is a documented BLOCKS_PROD gap (RI-006). This fixture locks the CURRENT lossy contract so a future fix can intentionally break + update this test. The original `expected_messages_input` (pre-Stage-C wire-up) encoded the desired multimodal shape; it has been preserved in `_desired_messages_input` as a forward-looking contract.

_known_gap.description: tool_result image blocks are dropped on the inbound leg — only the text content survives the flattening in tool_result_text(). Cross-wire equivalent on /responses preserves the multimodal payload via function_call_output.output as ContentItem[].
